about: teuf-teuf parts and contact schema (plan 3, Olog), the [substitute] operation, and asserts for invariants 1-3, 7 and the caption lags, RUN ON THE RENDERED FRAMES (verify_sheet.py, editor repair 1). The parts/contact schema is the mechanic-historian's; the motion laws are motion.py's (film_laws). sim.py's own asserts: superseded/mechanism-sim.json.

substitute.counterexample: wheels without the axle contact behave as rollers: rear wheel drops out, load stops at 0.9481 m

deviations_from_plan: Load is 180 px long (not 250): at 250 px the pusher stood off the left edge of frame A at 0 m. One mask in every trial.
Rollers: 7.0 s of push split 14.0-17.6 / 19.6-23.0 around the wait on two logs while log D is set down (plan: tau 2.2-4.8).
Resets between trials (13.0, 25.0, 34.0 s) are real cuts through a held black frame with a scratch wipe, declared with the camera cuts 16.2 / 18.8 s.
Four logs; log B is also squeezed out (21.3 s), so two logs are left behind. The cart shows two wheels, one per axle, so a rear wheel can fall out.
Caption 4 is timed to the pin pull (34.7 s), the bar's named cause.

film_laws.drag: 9 stick-slip lurches (smoothstep, 0.16 s each, every 0.75 s from 4.85 s), 1.20 m in total
film_laws.rollers: cycloid ease 0->150 px (14.0-17.6) and 150->300 px (19.6-23.0); carried logs at v/2, no slip; a log is squeezed out when it passes the stone's rear lip, rolls back (kick -260/-190 px/s, friction 520 px/s^2) and stops
film_laws.wheel: accelerate 0.8 s, cruise, decelerate 1.4 s: 8.00 m in 26.0-33.0; wheel angle = dx/R
film_laws.counter: the same input law from 35.0 s; pins pulled 34.7 s; loose wheels at v/2; the rear wheel rolls out, the platform drops and grinds (520 px/s^2) to a stop

ik_reach_excess_px.note: max distance by which a foot/hand target exceeds the test-shot puppet's limb lengths (Puppet: thigh 63s, shin 61s, arms 48s+46s; P s=1.2, C s=1.15). The large C value is the shove follow-through (13.04 s) and seated leg extensions; the animator's ik2 clamps, so residuals there are expected and reported in animation.json

layout_warning.why: with x0 = 330 and the approved 250 px stone, the rear face is at x 80 at 0 m; the pusher's hip is 134 px behind his hands (40 deg lean), so at 0 m his hip sits at x ~ -54 and his rear foot near -140. During the whole drag (0-1.2 m) and the first second of every later trial he is half cropped at frame left. kf-1 had the same issue less badly (smaller figures).
options: accept the crop (the reference frieze crops animals at the edges)
the director moves x0 to ~430 (8 m then reaches 1230; ticks and ghosts move with it)
narrow the stone to ~180 px (breaks the approved test-shot stone)
